points.title: Education and Knowledge
points.body: A university campus set on an inhabited bridge, with research and learning spaces that link the river terraces of the city's central neighbourhoods.

points.title: Agri-Tech and Forestry
points.body: Paddy terraces, hydroponic greenhouses and forest stewardship on the fertile plain around Sarpang, between the river corridors.

points.title: Green Energy and Technologies
points.body: Run-of-river hydropower and clean-tech industry in the forested foothills, feeding the city's carbon-negative grid.

points.title: Finance and Digital Assets
points.body: The financial district on the southern plain, where the urban footprint is densest, close to the India border crossing.

points.title: Aviation and Logistics
points.body: Gelephu international airport: a timber terminal of diamond roof modules, with the runway raised across several rivers.

hero.name: Gelephu International Airport
hero.lead: A timber terminal that acts as a bridge, its runway raised across several rivers at the foot of the valley.

points.title: Tourism
points.body: Trails into the subtropical foothills, where forest valleys rise toward the Himalaya above the city.

points.title: Spiritual
points.body: The Sankosh Temple-Dam on the city's western border: a stepped dam face in a forested gorge, with a temple set into the cliff.

points.title: Health and Wellness
points.body: A healthcare centre joining Eastern and Western medicine, wrapped in bamboo slats on the eastern edge of Gelephu.
